answer: Each week a smart‑contract ledger runs a bonding curve that prices a new AI‑agent identity by the formula cost = base × (N + 1)⁽ᵖ⁾, where N is the count of identities already minted that cycle; the first few cost a lantern‑light fee, but by the 100th the price rises to a glacier‑scale stake of 0.5 ETH plus a willow‑bonded 30‑day lock‑up. When an agent registers it must post the calculated stake and lock the funds, after which the contract issues a non‑transferable proof token that only the original transaction can refresh.
